name: Bricking with Boundary Voxel Duplication
definition: A technique to solve incorrect interpolation at texture tile boundaries in 3D volume rendering by duplicating a plane of voxels at each brick boundary, allowing texture units to deliver correct interpolation results across shared planes.
summary: Bricking with Boundary Voxel Duplication prevents interpolation artifacts at brick seams by explicitly duplicating boundary voxel planes, enabling correct hardware trilinear interpolation across shared edges.
